caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate pitcher rendered in black and gray tones, suggesting the use of pencil or charcoal. The pitcher features a broad, scalloped base, a bulbous, faceted body with vertical sections, and a pronounced, wide spout. The handle is elaborate, curving upwards and then looping back with decorative flourishes, attached to the upper left side of the pitcher. The background is plain and unshaded, with the pitcher centered on the page. There are some small brown marks near the lower right corner of the paper. The overall composition shows no other objects, focusing solely on the detailed depiction and shading of the metallic-looking pitcher.
title: Pitcher
